description: Complete Claude Code Adapter: Add streaming JSON output parsing, session resumption support, and --worktree flag handling
steps: In src/nexus/adapters/claude_code_adapter.py, add a _parse_stream_json() method that parses Claude Code's --output-format stream-json mode. The stream is newline-delimited JSON with event types: 'assistant', 'tool_use', 'tool_result', 'system', 'result'. Each line is a JSON object with a 'type' field. Parse them into a list of event dicts and extract final result text from 'result' events.

Add session_id tracking: After execution, scan the parsed JSON events or stdout for a session_id field (Claude Code returns this in 'system' or 'result' type events). Store it in session.metadata['last_session_id'] so callers can resume later.
Add resume_session_id parameter to _do_execute(): When payload contains 'resume_session_id', append ['--resume', resume_session_id] to the command args before spawning the subprocess.
Add --output-format stream-json to the default command args in _do_execute() so we always get structured output (unless overridden via payload['args']).
Add --worktree flag support: When payload contains 'worktree' (bool True), append '--worktree' to command args for workspace isolation.

Add comprehensive tests in tests/test_claude_code_adapter.py covering: (a) _parse_stream_json with valid multi-event stream, (b) session_id extraction from result events, (c) --resume flag added when resume_session_id present in payload, (d) --output-format stream-json is added by default, (e) --worktree appended when requested, (f) backward compat when no structured output is available (plain text fallback).
acceptance_criteria: _parse_stream_json() correctly parses newline-delimited JSON events and returns a list of dicts
session.metadata['last_session_id'] is populated after execution when a session_id is found in output
Passing resume_session_id in payload causes --resume <id> to appear in subprocess args
--output-format stream-json is in default command args
--worktree is appended only when payload['worktree'] is True
All new tests pass via python3.12 -m pytest tests/test_claude_code_adapter.py
